definitions.gloss: osechi; traditional Japanese New Year dishes
definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese cuisine prepared for the New Year celebration, consisting of various dishes with symbolic meanings, typically served in special lacquered boxes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{元日|がんじつ}→元日：00059_ganjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、おせち{料理|りょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: On New Year's morning, I ate osechi dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おせち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧みた。
examples.english: This year I tried making osechi myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧おせち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I ordered osechi from a department store.

notes:
FULL FORM:
おせち{料理|りょうり} (osechi ryouri) is the full term.

COMMON DISHES:
- ⟦{黒豆|くろまめ}→黒豆：30552_kuromame⟧ (black soybeans - for health)
- ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧ (herring roe - for fertility)
- ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧⟦きんとん→きんとん：28495_kinton⟧ (sweet chestnuts - for wealth)
- {伊達巻|だてまき} (rolled omelet - for learning)
- ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦かまぼこ→かまぼこ：10307_kamaboko⟧ (fish cake - good fortune)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Osechi dishes are designed to be prepared in advance and eaten cold over the first few days of the New Year, allowing families to rest from cooking.
